text:
alex: Pushing canary release v2.14.3 -> eu-west canaries. Rolling at 5% with adaptive-batch feature-flag enabled (adaptive-batch=true). Will monitor for 10m before increasing.

Priya K: noted. I'll watch the dashboard. tagging @Sam (oncall) in case we need to escalate.

SRE Bot: :rotating_light: Alert: canary-eu-west-1 | 503 spike on inference-proxy | 5xx-rate 18% | 60s window

alex: saw that. rolling back batch worker pods to 0 and toggling adaptive-batch=false via ff toggle.

mike: logs from proxy show this pattern:
```
2026-03-15T20:15:02Z error: downstream kvcache deadlock: wait_for_lock timeout
2026-03-15T20:15:03Z warn: backpressure applied, queue_len=1200
2026-03-15T20:15:03Z error: inference-proxy 503 upstream_timeout
```

Priya K: hmm deadlock in kvcache after the new batching config. Are we sure the canary pod image has the latest kv lock fix? That was supposed to be in 2.14.3.

alex: it's the build that includes the batching change only, i didn't include the new lock-timeout patch. my bad. initiating rollback of canary to v2.14.2 now.

SRE Bot: :information_source: Rollback started by alex. Rolling canary groups to v2.14.2. Estimated 2m.

Sam (oncall): I'll take the handoff if this doesn't clear in 5m. Priya, can you confirm customer-facing latency/5xx graph for the past 15m? any VIP customers hit?

Priya K: customer impact: API error rate increased from 0.3% -> 2.8% for a subset of eu-west customers on the high-concurrency path. No broad outages yet. Highlighted customers: alpha-inc and betaapps on eu-west.

mike: adding that our autoscaler also started spawning extra proxy replicas which amplified KV contention. there's a feedback loop between adaptive-batch and proxy concurrency.

alex: rollback complete on 3 of 4 canary slices, last slice draining. SRE Bot shows 503 rate falling.

SRE Bot: :white_check_mark: Rollback complete. 503 spike mitigated, 5xx-rate back to 0.4% over 2m window.

Sam (oncall): thanks. I'm keeping the channel open for 30m. Next steps: 1) disable adaptive-batch flag org-wide? 2) coordinate eng-runtime to land lock-timeout patch + integration test for scaler interactions.

Priya K: agree. Do NOT flip org-wide. Keep 5% canaries paused. eng-runtime, can you triage the lock-timeout patch and confirm timeline?

eng-runtime: We see root cause: batching increased request fan-out to KV shard causing lock starvation. We already have a patch (increase lock backoff + per-request token bucket). ETA for PR review + canary bake: ~4 hours.

mike: also recommend adding a short-circuit circuit-breaker in the proxy for KV wait > 200ms to avoid 503 cascades.

alex: apologies for the slip. I'll open a postmortem draft and list corrective actions: disable ff default, add integration test, proxy breaker, and ensure builds include both batching and lock patches together.

Sam (oncall): For the immediate customer comms, Priya - can you prep a note for alpha-inc / betaapps support contact? mention short-lived elevated errors during a canary deploy and that rollback resolved it.

Priya K: on it. I'll send a targeted message and CC account team.

SRE Bot: :page_facing_up: Incident log appended: incident-3612345000. Pager cleared. Remaining actions assigned to eng-runtime and alex.

Sam (oncall): closing handoff. I'll follow up in 30m and then transition to normal ops. Good job on the quick rollback. :thumbsup:

alex: thanks team. will follow up with postmortem and patch timeline.
